title: FATE_HUBBLE_IN_READOUT_DISTANCE_VIA_CR013_SHRINKAGE

measurement_inputs_external_not_catalog_.H_0_source: BAO-side anchor; same as CR018b, CR019, CR001c@19

closed_form_derivation_chain.step_3_apply_shrinkage: H_readout = H_native * (1 - A_los); at saturation H_inf_readout = H_0 * ((pi-1)/pi)^(3/2)

reported_evidence_not_gates.E1_E2: A_los, c_eff, H(z) native and readout track at z in {0, z_eq_Lambda, z_acc, 1, 5, 10, 100, 1090, 1e6, fate}

verdict_ladder_first.PASS: P1, P2, P3 all hold within tolerance
verdict_ladder_first.FAIL: any of P1, P2, P3 fails its tolerance
verdict_ladder_first.BOUNDARY: not applicable (algebra either agrees or it does not)

rule_9_falsifier: The claim that SAM's substrate identities composed with the sealed CR013 line-of-sight shrinkage produce H_inf_readout = H_0 * ((pi-1)/pi)^(3/2) as a consistent closed-form identity.
verdict_reason: P1, P2, P3 all hold to machine precision (~1e-16); substrate identities and CR013 shrinkage compose to H_inf_readout = 38.7005 km/s/Mpc at H_0 = 68.76.
headline: H_inf_readout = H_0 * ((pi-1)/pi)^(3/2) ~ 38.70 km/s/Mpc; ratio to today's H_0 is 0.5628 (a closed form in pi alone)
